errors.text: The hypothesis replaces the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi FCC/B2 eutectic alloy and HPHT treatment with a refractory BCC alloy and nanoprecipitation route.
No specific processing temperature, time, pressure, or cooling schedule is supplied, so the proposed intervention is not reproducible.

The predicted room-temperature yield strength is not directly established by the quoted evidence, which reports 2.15 GPa strength at ambient temperature but specifies 1.05 GPa yield strength at 800 degrees Celsius.
